system.description:
Requirements: Frost Dragon Style, Training (3) and Expertise (3) in Melee Weapons or Ranged Weapons, 5 abilities with the Frost Dragon Style trait, and you must receive training from a master of this style, or have access to their teachings

Cost: 3 Focus

Range: Self

Without warning, you strike with an impossibly thin blade conjured from pure ice.

Once per turn, when a creature enters the range of your equipped weapon, or performs an Action while within range of your equipped weapon, you may spend -3 Focus before the attack is rolled to declare your use of this ability as a Reaction that resolves first.

Make an Attack Check against that enemy. You have Greater Advantage, and the attack ignores Armor. If your attack deals damage, that enemy must make an opposed Resilience Check or be Stunned until the start of your next turn.

You may choose to end Frost Dragon Style when you perform this attack to double the Damage inflicted. If you do so, you may not enter Frost Dragon Style again until the start of your next turn.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.kNutGQUTBPJiqyvb]{Whispering Blade}
